episodes.186087: Warming temperatures and areas of mixed rain and snow caused snowmelt flooding of streets across Anchorage.  Rainfall of 0.30 combined with the warming temperatures overran storm drains which were covered in ice and snow and unable to contain the runoff.
episodes.186383: A warm front stalled near the FL-GA state line as a broad area of low pressure moved along the front and across north Florida through the day. Above normal precipitable water content (> 1.8 inches) combined with low level isentropic lift and a strong SW low level jet near 35 kts produced locally heavy rainfall of 2-3 inches.
episodes.186639: A line of strong storms ahead of a cold front moved across portions of the coastal waters with gusty winds.  A 34 knot wind gust was measured at the St George Island Bridge WeatherSTEM.

events.narrative: The Eddy Tower RAWS measured 2.92 inches in 24 hours.
A mesonet station at the Suwannee Forestry center measured a 24 hour of rainfall of 2.51 inches.
A mesonet site near Olustee measured a 24 hour rainfall total of 3.02 inches.
A mesonet station in Macclenny measured a 24 hour rainfall of 2.99 inches.
A mesonet station in Fernandina Beach measured a 24 hr rainfall of 2.68 inches.
A mesonet station in Wildlight measured a 24 hr rainfall total of 2.71 inches.

events.county: Coastal Waters From Ochlockonee River To Apalachicola Fl Out To 20 Nm
events.narrative: The St George Island Bridge WeatherSTEM gusted to 34 knots.
Significant ponding of several inches of water on Hickel Parkway due to snowmelt flooding.  Ponding was severe enough where vehicles were swerving to avoid the flooded areas.
